title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_context: Welcomes the fact that inflation in the euro area has been brought down to the European Central Bank target level after reaching its peak of 10.6 % in October 2022; notes, however, that inflation remains at different levels across the Member States, with some having higher levels, including those with energy-intensive industries; notes that both core inflation and inflation expectations still remain above target level; underlines the continued impact of food and energy inflation on European households; notes that inflation affects income groups unevenly, with low-income households being hit the hardest;
